epics.title: Pipeline Unblocking and Review Resolution
epics.jtbd: When a project manager reviews a stalled pipeline, I want the system to successfully process stuck tasks, so that the workflow continues without manual intervention.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of tasks stalled in BLOCKED_BY_REVIEW from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Patch the logic flaw preventing task 529e5252-040a-4889-9f61-366ea6e9e089 from exiting pending_review

slices.title: Fix pending_review state transition logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pending_review patch for this epic, I want to fix the state transition bug, so that the pipeline queue resumes processing.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given task 529e5252-040a-4889-9f61-366ea6e9e089 is in pending_review
When the patched logic is applied
Then the task transitions out of pending_review successfully
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce pending_review timeout errors from 100% to 0%

epics.title: Task Resolution and Falsification Readiness Pipeline Fix
epics.jtbd: When an auditor evaluates a project cycle, I want tasks to transition to resolved and update the falsification readiness correctly, so that the project cycle can finish successfully.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase task resolution count from 0 to >0 and falsification readiness from <90% to >90%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Task progression and readiness evaluation logic
requirements: R1: Patch the logic flaw preventing tasks from transitioning to the resolved state
R2: Fix the falsification readiness evaluation to properly compute against the >90% threshold

slices.title: Patch task resolution and readiness calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the resolution and readiness fix for this epic, I want to repair the progression logic, so that tasks resolve correctly and readiness meets the threshold.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given tasks are ready to be resolved and the system evaluates readiness
When the fix runs and task statuses are updated
Then tasks transition to resolved and falsification readiness computes as >90%
slices.tocConstraintRef: Task status update and readiness computation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the cycle success rate of task resolution updates to 100%
